response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptional candidate with 20+ years of full-stack development experience and direct expertise in the primary tech stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React). His current role at re:cinq working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks directly addresses the job's AI agent development requirement. He demonstrates solid engineering practices, full-stack capabilities, database experience (MongoDB, MySQL), Docker/Kubernetes proficiency, and AWS cloud platform knowledge. While some testing frameworks and secondary languages (Python/Kotlin) lack explicit documentation, his proven commitment to testing culture and code craftsmanship make him well-suited for this mid-senior position.
strengths: 20+ years of full-stack development expertise spanning TypeScript, Node.js, React with proven ability to architect and optimize scalable systems
Current AI-agent infrastructure and MCP development experience directly addresses core job requirement
Strong testing culture, code craftsmanship focus (TDD), and demonstrated architecture skills across enterprise and startup environments
concerns: Limited explicit mention of required testing frameworks (Jest/Vitest/Playwright) despite demonstrated TDD commitment throughout career
No documented experience with Python or Kotlin, which are listed as required secondary languages
Cloud platform experience appears limited to AWS; no evidence of GCP or Azure exposure

key_factors.factor: Current AI-agent infrastructure and MCP expertise
